definitions.explanation: The middle portion of a calendar month, roughly the 10th to 20th. Combines {月|つき} ("month") with {半|なか}ば ("middle, halfway point"). Used both as a time expression in itself and to anchor schedules: "by mid-month," "around the middle of the month," etc.

examples.japanese: {月|つき}{半|なか}ば⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{払|はら}う→払う：00535_harau⟧。
examples.english: I'll pay in the middle of the month.

examples.japanese: ⟦{報告書|ほうこくしょ}→報告書：06744_houkokusho⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{月|つき}{半|なか}ば⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{提出|ていしゅつ}して→提出する：19644_teishutsusuru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please submit the report by the middle of the month.

examples.japanese: ⟦{月初|つきはじ}め→月初め：15144_tsukihajime⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{忙|いそが}しい→忙しい：00591_isogashii⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{打|う}ち{合|あ}わせ→打ち合わせ：07155_uchiawase⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{月|つき}{半|なか}ばあたりにしましょう。
examples.english: The beginning of the month is busy, so let's set the meeting for around mid-month.

examples.japanese: {月|つき}{半|なか}ば⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{過|す}ぎる→過ぎる：01219_sugiru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{月末|げつまつ}→月末：00070_getsumatsu⟧{締切|しめきり}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{気|き}→気：02199_ki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なり→なる：01970_naru⟧{始|はじ}める。
examples.english: Once we get past the middle of the month, I start worrying about the end-of-month deadlines.

notes:
{月|つき}{半|なか}ば is a fairly common time expression for the middle stretch of a calendar month. The ⟦{半|なか}ば→半ば：03500_nakaba⟧ element is the same word that appears in many "middle of X" expressions: ⟦{年|とし}→年：00486_toshi⟧⟦{半|なか}ば→半ば：03500_nakaba⟧ ("middle of the year"), ⟦{道|みち}→道：00505_michi⟧⟦{半|なか}ば→半ば：03500_nakaba⟧ ("halfway along the road / partway done").

FORMS:
- ⟦{月|つき}→月：02230_tsuki⟧ ("month") + ⟦{半|なか}ば→半ば：03500_nakaba⟧ ("middle, midway point") → {月|つき}{半|なか}ば

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {月|つき}{半|なか}ば⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: in mid-month
- {月|つき}{半|なか}ば⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: by mid-month
- {月|つき}{半|なか}ば⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{過|す}ぎる→過ぎる：01219_sugiru⟧: to pass the middle of the month
- {月|つき}{半|なか}ばあたり: around mid-month
- {月|つき}{半|なか}ば⟦{頃|ごろ}→頃：00932_goro⟧: roughly mid-month

SIMILAR / RELATED TERMS:
- ⟦{月初|つきはじ}め→月初め：15144_tsukihajime⟧ / ⟦{月初|げっしょ}→月初：18530_gessho⟧: beginning of the month
- ⟦{月末|げつまつ}→月末：00070_getsumatsu⟧: end of the month
- ⟦{中旬|ちゅうじゅん}→中旬：11309_chuujun⟧: middle ten days of the month (a more formal/precise term, used in news and documents)
- ⟦{上旬|じょうじゅん}→上旬：17767_joujun⟧: first ten days of the month
- ⟦{下旬|げじゅん}→下旬：00062_gejun⟧: last ten days of the month
- ⟦{年|とし}→年：00486_toshi⟧⟦{半|なか}ば→半ば：03500_nakaba⟧: middle of the year

USAGE:
- {月|つき}{半|なか}ば is conversational and slightly soft compared to ⟦{中旬|ちゅうじゅん}→中旬：11309_chuujun⟧, which is more precise and used in business writing, schedules, and weather forecasts. "6⟦{月|がつ}→月：30418_gatsu⟧⟦{中旬|ちゅうじゅん}→中旬：11309_chuujun⟧" is the natural way to write "mid-June" in a printed schedule, while "{月|つき}{半|なか}ば" is more typical in speech.
- ⟦{半|なか}ば→半ば：03500_nakaba⟧ can also be used as a noun on its own meaning "halfway, in the middle of doing," as in ⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦{半|なか}ば→半ば：03500_nakaba⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{帰|かえ}る→帰る：00508_kaeru⟧ ("to leave with the work half-done").
